original: Design a real-time voice agent for a citizen helpline in Hindi and three regional languages, targeting sub-250 ms perceived latency over a phone line.
originalAnswer: - Answer: [Design a Real-Time Voice AI Agent](https://outcomeschool.com/blog/design-a-real-time-voice-ai-agent), [How do you build a latency budget for a voice AI agent?](https://outcomeschool.com/blog/voice-agent-latency-budget), [How does the voice-to-voice latency of a voice agent get measured?](https://outcomeschool.com/blog/voice-to-voice-latency), [Why does the time-to-first-audio matter more than total response time?](https://outcomeschool.com/blog/time-to-first-audio), [How does speculative LLM generation start replying before the user finishes?](https://outcomeschool.com/blog/speculative-generation-in-voice-agents) and [How do filler phrases hide latency in a voice agent?](https://outcomeschool.com/blog/filler-phrases-in-voice-agents)
